Ambition

Driven by Curiosity,
Built on Passion

My journey into web development has been powered by curiosity, persistence, and continuous learning. I am a second-year student at the Lebanese University, specializing in Front-End Web Development.

I have built 5 strong websites completely through self-learning, including my first professional project — a high-quality website for Darwish Trading. Every line of code is a step forward in my mission to become a Full-Stack Developer.

I don't consider myself an expert yet. But I have a strong passion for learning, building, and pushing myself every single day. My goal is to continue growing until I can create impactful digital products.

My Learning Story

Accelerated by AI, Driven by Passion

AI tools became valuable learning companions — not replacements, but accelerators that helped me think differently and gain practical experience faster.

Claude AI

My primary coding assistant. I use it to understand complex concepts, improve code quality, discover best practices, and accelerate my learning process.

Google Gemini

I use ChatGPT to brainstorm ideas, debug code, explore different solutions, and get instant answers to development challenges during my learning process.

Self-Learning Mindset

Used for research, design inspiration, exploring different approaches, and getting creative ideas for web development and technology exploration.

"Every expert was once a beginner who refused to quit. I may be early in my journey, but my ambition has no limits."

How I Work

My Development Process

Every project follows a structured approach that ensures quality, clarity, and results clients can measure.

01
Research
Understand your business, goals, target audience, and competitors before writing a single line of code.
02
Wireframe
Plan the structure, layout, and user flow. Every click and scroll is designed with purpose and intention.
03
Development
Build with clean, semantic HTML, modern CSS, and optimized JavaScript. Fully responsive from day one.
04
Optimization
Performance tuning, SEO, accessibility, and cross-browser testing. Lighthouse score 95+ is the target.
05
Deployment
Launch, handover, and post-launch support. I stay available until you are fully satisfied with the result.

Why Web Development?

The Future is Digital

Web development is not just a career — it is the language of the future.

Global Impact
Every website reaches a global audience. The ability to build something that millions of people interact with is an extraordinary power.
Massive Market Demand
Skilled web developers are among the most in-demand professionals worldwide. Every business needs a digital presence.
Limitless Opportunities
Freelancing, startups, remote work, full-time positions, or building your own product — web development opens every door.
Creative Expression
Web development is where technology meets art. I can turn ideas into interactive, beautiful experiences that users remember.
Build From Nothing
Starting with a blank screen and ending with a fully functional product is one of the most satisfying feelings in tech.
Lebanon's Digital Future
I want to be part of building Lebanon's digital future and connecting local businesses to the global economy.
